description: +EV bets: FanDuel prices that pay more than the fair chance, measured against the Novig exchange's no-vig price for the same side and line. Use it for "what are the best +EV FanDuel bets right now?" or "is there value on <player> points?". Each row has the FanDuel price, the fair probability and price, ev_pct, edge_cents, Kelly stakes, main_line and confidence. books=fanduel,draftkings adds DraftKings prices. Free plan: top 10, five minutes behind. A default call costs 3 credits (table: https://fanduelapi.com/credits).

alt_lines.description: Include alternate lines. Default false (main lines only).

league.description: League code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, NCAAB, NCAAF, or a soccer league such as EPL, LALIGA, UCL, MLS.

min_prob.description: Minimum fair probability in percent. Default 15.

player.description: Player name or part of it.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.
